SELECTED_INDEX: 10
CONFIDENCE: 0.62
EXPLANATION: The spectrum shows an aliphatic aldehyde: a carbonyl at 1724 cm⁻¹ (typical ν(C=O) for saturated aldehydes), a weak aldehydic C–H stretch near 2740 cm⁻¹, and an aldehydic C–H wag around 804 cm⁻¹. Strong aliphatic C–H stretches at 2883/2943/2972 cm⁻¹ support a saturated chain (GFQ-003). The pair of bands at 1037 and 1167 cm⁻¹ are consistent with ether C–O–C stretching modes, favoring molecules that contain both an ether and an aldehyde. Candidate 10 (CCOCC(C=O)CC) matches these features and has two CH3 groups accounting for the double CH3 rocking near 964/986 cm⁻¹. Other candidates lacking an aldehyde (e.g., 5) or containing NH/OH (2, 7, 9, 4) are incompatible with the observed bands.
